title: Formula UA27 low-voltage systems
subtitle: Vehicle electrical integration shaped by packaging, safety interfaces, accessibility, and team coordination.

image.alt: Formula UA27 at its unveiling, showing the full vehicle context for low-voltage electrical integration

objective: Plan and integrate the low-voltage system for Formula UA27 around the vehicle package, including power distribution, control hardware, sensors, and safety interfaces.
context: Formula EV work requires electrical decisions to coexist with the chassis, vehicle packaging, team schedule, and the practical need to inspect and service the car.
contribution: Lead low-voltage electrical system planning and integration; coordinate board-level hardware, safety interfaces, sensor integration, and power-distribution work with mechanical and software teammates.

decision.label: ENGINEERING FOCUS
decision.title: Treat the electrical system as part of the vehicle package.
decision.text: Low-voltage work is not isolated from the mechanical system. Component placement, access, and integration are considered alongside the electrical function so the team can build, inspect, and troubleshoot the vehicle as a complete system.

results: Current subsystem leadership role for Formula UA27.
Coordinates low-voltage planning across board-level hardware, sensors, safety interfaces, and vehicle packaging.
